correctness.rationale: Direct commutator expansion gives tr(A²B²)-tr(ABAB)=det(AB-BA)=Δ for A=[[a,u],[v,0]],B=[[d,w],[z,0]]. Three single-vital-rate substitutions yield exact signed squares. Exact rational witness det(I-C),det(I-T) signs with common det<1 certify both possible persistence reversals. Cyclic rotations classify all binary fixed-multiset words of lengths <=3 and the two length-four 2+2 classes.
